facts.fact: Xalam Analytics' January 2026 brief describes the Central African Backbone project as ongoing to expand Congo's fibre backbone, connecting to secondary towns and neighbouring countries; the brief gives no date for the work beyond its own January 2026 publication, taken as the date.

Xalam Analytics' January 2026 brief states that submarine cables have been deployed across the Congo river to connect Brazzaville and Kinshasa (DRC); no date for the deployment is given, so the brief's January 2026 publication date is used.

systems.country_label: Submarine cables across the Congo river
